½ FractionCompare

Two fractions are shown and you must quickly determine which is larger. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Compare the two fractions to determine which is larger.
  2. Cross-multiplication: compare a/b vs c/d by comparing a×d vs c×b.
  3. Look for fractions close to 0, 1/2, or 1 as anchors.
  4. Simplify fractions mentally when possible.
  5. Speed and accuracy both count toward your score.
